Recorded trails nearest the stops: St. Giorgi Monastery (6.5 km from Jakupica), St. Giorgi Monastery (5 km from Bogomila Falls), Св. Недела (9.3 km from Jasen) and Св. Недела (1.8 km from Vrelo Cave), and 1 more. Elevation runs from 600 m at Vrelo Cave to 2,225 m at Jakupica. Moderate: days of up to 22 km and 800 m of ascent, staying below 3,000 m.
